prompt.en: Having shown that the Spirit is a Person, what does this unit establish about which Person He is?

prompt.sw: Eleza mfano wa umeme na funzo lake kwa kumwamini Roho.

prompt.sw: Eleza fundisho la Mungu mmoja na jinsi Roho anavyohusika, ukijilinda usimchukulie kama kiumbe duni.
